title: lycianthes ciliolata
intro: Lycianthes ciliolata, commonly known as Purple Flowering Nightshade or Purple Coral Berry, is a plant species in the Solanaceae family. It is a shrubby perennial herb that is native to the tropical regions of Asia and the Pacific Islands. The health benefits of Lycianthes ciliolata include its potential anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent the growth of certain microorganisms. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
